title: Maximum Of Minimum Values In All Subarrays
description:
For every window length from `1` through `nums.length`, find the minimum value in each contiguous window of that length, then return the largest of those minimums. The result at index `i` corresponds to window length `i + 1`.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [0,1,2,4]
Output: [4,2,1,0]
```

```text
Input: nums = [10,20,50,10]
Output: [50,20,10,10]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
